# Toffin Pakistan

> Toffin Pakistan is a B2B distributor of premium coffee machines and a provider of integrated solutions for the HORECA (Hotel, Restaurant, Café) industry in Indonesia since 2007. It serves 15,000+ cafés, restaurants, and hotels in 19 cities through a nationwide branch network.

Toffin is an official partner of world-class brands such as Victoria Arduino, Nuova Simonelli, and SMEG. Beyond coffee machine distribution, Toffin supplies F&B ingredients, after-sales services (installation, calibration, servicing), barista training, and a B2B digital platform (Toffin App — Product of the Year 2024 winner).

Head office: Plot #34, Puran Arcade, SCHS, Sector E-11/2, Islamabad.
Contact: +92 309 1115951 · toffinpakistan@gmail.com

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.toffin.pk/): Overview of Toffin's services — coffee machine distribution, HORECA ingredients, a 19-city network, global brand partners.
- [About Toffin](https://www.toffin.pk/about): Company profile, nearly two decades of history, values (quality, partnership, certified expertise), and its position as a global top-5 distributor.
- [Support & After-Sales Service](https://www.toffin.pk/support): Coffee machine installation, calibration, and servicing by a team of certified technicians. Official warranty, original spare parts, fast response in 19 cities. Includes a technical FAQ and the list of branch cities.
- [Toffin App](https://www.toffin.pk/toffin-app): Product of the Year 2024 B2B digital platform — ingredient ordering, machine monitoring, and café operations management via smartphone. 5,000+ active users, 4.8 rating.
- [Co-Creation](https://www.toffin.pk/co-creation): Gallery of flavour & recipe collaborations between Toffin and leading Indonesian F&B brands (Gigi Susu, Makmur Jaya, Tous Les Jours, Union, Kibo, Braci, etc.). Signature menus made with premium ingredients: Fabbri Amarena, Fabbri Pistachio, FO Syrup, and Premium Matcha by Toffin.
- [Contact](https://www.toffin.pk/contact): Contact form, head office address, branch map, business hours (Monday–Friday 08:30–17:30 WIB).

## External products & services

- [Toffin Online Store](https://shop.toffin.id): Full catalogue of coffee machines, grinders, and F&B ingredients for online purchase.
- [Espresso Machines](https://shop.toffin.id/category/coffee-machine/383): Commercial espresso machines from premium global brands.
- [Coffee Grinders](https://shop.toffin.id/category/coffee-grinder/385): Commercial grinders for cafés and roasteries.
- [Ingredients](https://shop.toffin.id/category/ingredients/384): F&B ingredients — syrups, beverage powders, sachets, and consumable supplies.
- [Toffin Insight](https://insight.toffin.id): Educational blog on the coffee industry, F&B trends, and HORECA technical know-how.
